front.method: remove whole-arm lock only; independently restore original/new weapon, head, boots, complete hand/wrist boxes, arm warm skin, gold/warm details and alpha-edge protection
front.skin_evidence_scope: Bright skin gate inside previously audited hand cores. Full hand/wrist windows, including ambiguous shadows, are protected separately; colour gate is not claimed to segment all skin.

local_calibration_report.method: separate conservative wine/sleeve/trouser ROIs; bounded low-frequency ICC Lab L affine plus signed a/b offset; original fine-L residual
local_calibration_report.Lab_encoding: Pillow ImageCms sRGB to ICC Lab D50; L8/2.55=Lstar, signed a/b decoded from NumPy bytes
local_calibration_report.status: numerical palette candidate; not artistic acceptance; no production writes
limitations: Material/geometry proxy masks are conservative, not manually traced semantic masks. Excluded seams and boundaries retain the input colour.
Exact weapon and ambiguous hand/pouch boundaries require caller-provided protect_mask on the final guide geometry.
Distribution differences include pose, baked shading and view. DeltaE76 between unpaired ROI medians is a diagnostic, not perceptual/artistic acceptance.
Preserving fine-L residual is before ICC quantization, mask blending and sRGB gamut clipping; exact RGB fold identity is not claimed.

front.status: feature protection numerically verified; material masks remain conservative proxies; artistic review pending
